verses.english: Five Discourses on Not Understanding Form, Etc.

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca—
ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo …pe…
rūpe kho, vaccha, ananubodhā …pe… “rūpanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ananubodhā …pe….
verses.english: “Vaccha, it is because of not understanding form …
